en.text:
Kills or scoring 5 hits with Weapons matching your Super Element grant Super Energy based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 1.5%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 2%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: ?%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 2.5%
• Players: 2.5?%

While your Super is charged:
Kills with Weapons matching your Super's Element grant 4 Stacks of Subclass-Matching Weapon Surge for <pve 11 /> <pvp [6] /> seconds.

After casting your Super Ability, gain x4 <arc/>Arc, <solar/>Solar, <void/>Void, <stasis/>Stasis, and <stasis/>Strand Weapon Surge for 10 seconds, and 'Harmonic Munitions' for 15 seconds.

Harmonic Munitions causes weapons that are the same element as your super to trigger an element-matching explosion on hit. Explosions deal <pve 180 /> <pvp [?] /> damage in a 6 meter radius and can trigger once per second.
